title: Asymptotic lower bound on expected visits
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a finite, nonempty vertex set $V$, with positive degree. Suppose every pair of vertices is connected by a finite sequence of neighbor steps, and no Boolean coloring assigns opposite colors across every neighbor step. For any vertices $u,v$, there is an integer $N_0$ such that for every integer $N\ge N_0$, the expected number of visits to $v$ during the length-$N$ random walk started at $u$ is at least $N/(2|V|)$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is connected by finite sequences of neighbor steps
$G$ has no Boolean coloring that flips across every neighbor step
$N$ is an integer with $N_0\le N$ in the conclusion
